name: v18.11.1
body:
## @oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core

### Added

- `Tokenizer.countLatestTurn`: counts a message as the transcript's latest assistant turn, which an Anthropic Messages replay keeps byte-for-byte ([#15791](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15791) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- `Agent.prioritizeSteering`: moves given pending steering messages ahead of older ones so one-at-a-time delivery takes them first ([#15642](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15642))

### Fixed

- Fixed a Cursor tool call re-sent by the server persisting two results under one id; the re-run's result replaces the first ([#15749](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15749))
- Fixed compaction keeping more recent history than `keepRecentTokens` when the latest Claude turn on the Anthropic Messages API ended its tool calls on `stop` or `length`: the replay keeps that turn's signed reasoning, but the cut point counted only its visible blocks ([#15791](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15791) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-ai

### Added

- Added image support for native OpenAI Decisions and Workers AI judgments, prompted vision chat, and auth-gateway System One requests; images exceeding a judgment API's documented caps (e.g. Clef's 4 images, 4 MiB each) are rejected locally ([#15471](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15471) by [@anatoli-tsinovoy](https://github.com/anatoli-tsinovoy)).
- `isSurvivingAssistant` in `providers/transform-messages`: whether an assistant turn reaches a replay, malformed tool calls dropped first, so callers outside `transformMessages` pick the same latest turn ([#15791](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15791) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))

### Fixed

- Fixed Codex-hosted image generation ignoring the requested `aspect_ratio`/`image_size`, and `3:2`/`2:3` requests sending no size to OpenAI image models ([#15601](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15601) by [@chulmin-dev](https://github.com/chulmin-dev))
- Fixed Claude subagents failing to return structured results when `yield` arguments arrived as invalid JSON ([#15605](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15605) by [@farnoy](https://github.com/farnoy))
- Fixed turns stopping instead of retrying when a gateway reports its upstream WebSocket closed before `response.completed` ([#15628](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15628) by [@nqrwhal](https://github.com/nqrwhal)).
- Fixed Claude on Google Vertex ignoring `cacheRetention: "long"`: prompt caches now get the 1h TTL instead of expiring after 5 minutes, and the `extended-cache-ttl` beta (which Vertex rejects) is never sent there ([#15505](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15505) by [@hpost](https://github.com/hpost))
- Fixed Gemini tool continuations failing on OpenAI-compatible gateways that return `reasoning_signature`, including restored sessions ([#15678](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15678) by [@Zzz141592653](https://github.com/Zzz141592653))
- Fixed Cursor sessions failing every rebuilt request with `PROVIDER_ERROR` after the server re-sent a tool call: the call is recorded once, and histories that already repeat it replay it once with its latest result ([#15749](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15749))
- Fixed Cursor turns cut off mid-stream failing every retry with `PROVIDER_ERROR` until you sent a new message; the retry now starts a fresh Cursor conversation ([#15830](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15830))
- Fixed malformed image-generation inputs being forwarded to providers or reported as credential/upstream errors ([#15765](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15765) by [@anatoli-tsinovoy](https://github.com/anatoli-tsinovoy)).
- Fixed broker-backed auth-gateway processes retaining a cache entry for every distinct client session indefinitely under sustained traffic ([#15841](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15841)).
- Fixed turns ending on a pinned error when a provider reports "temporarily unavailable" or finishes with an `unknown`, `other` or `unspecified` finish reason: these now retry automatically ([#15424](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15424) by [@lockwo](https://github.com/lockwo))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

### Fixed

- Enabled long prompt-cache retention (`ttl: "1h"`) for Claude models on `google-vertex` ([#15505](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15505) by [@hpost](https://github.com/hpost))
- Fixed Gemini 4 Argon on Google Vertex and the Gemini API failing every request with "Thinking budget is not supported for this model": Gemini 4 now sends `thinkingLevel` instead of `thinkingBudget`, and Argon offers only the low, medium, and high levels Google accepts ([#15643](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15643) by [@kevcube](https://github.com/kevcube))
- Fixed the Antigravity model selector offering roster rows the backend marks disabled (`disabled: true`, e.g. `gemini-4-argon-disabled` on accounts without Argon access), which answered `Cloud Code Assist API error (404): Requested entity was not found.`; discovery now skips them the way it already skips `isInternal` rows ([#15684](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15684) by [@CharleoYang](https://github.com/CharleoYang))
- Removed Google Antigravity's Gemini 3.5 Flash and its `gemini-3-flash` alias from the model list; Antigravity retired them and answers every request with a retirement notice instead of a reply ([#15445](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15445) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed `xai-oauth` Grok 4.20 models (`grok-4.20-0309-reasoning`, `-non-reasoning`, `grok-4.20-multi-agent-0309`) advertising a 2M context window when the SuperGrok API rejects prompts over 1M; auto-compaction and context usage now work from the 1M window ([#15443](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15443) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed trailing-dot `localhost.` and `*.local.` custom endpoints losing local-backend compatibility settings ([#15798](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15798)).

## @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

### Added

- Added image attachments to single and batch eval `judge()`/`judge_batch()` calls (local paths or embedded images); image judgments skip candidates without image support and fail explicitly instead of dropping images ([#15471](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15471) by [@anatoli-tsinovoy](https://github.com/anatoli-tsinovoy))
- Added a job tree to `/jobs`, `/jobs full` and the jobs pill's sheet, in the terminal UI and over ACP: subagents' background jobs now appear nested under the task that runs them, with the busiest branches listed first; only your own jobs offer Cancel ([#15854](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15854) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- Added `ctx.ui.getEditorComponent()` so extensions can wrap the active custom editor factory instead of replacing it ([#8655](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/8655) by [@jovi-tsx](https://github.com/jovi-tsx))

### Changed

- Reduced memory used by bundled model catalog data in standalone and npm installs ([#15876](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15876) by [@iliaal](https://github.com/iliaal)).

### Fixed

- Fixed `/shake` and automatic shake leaving old transcript rows in native scrollback or obscuring the start of a response beside the Todo HUD ([#15877](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15877)).
- Fixed `write` making Rust source files beginning with `#![...]` executable instead of preserving their permissions ([#15858](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15858)).
- Fixed the startup status bar preview showing a previous session's model instead of the default model ([#15865](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15865)).
- Fixed `length`-stop recovery with a lowered `compaction.thresholdTokens` counting the discarded output against the threshold, so a reasoning-only cut compacted without the retry hint and a truncated answer was discarded instead of kept ([#15870](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15870))
- Fixed `read` on a directory showing `(empty directory)` when the directory itself is unreadable, and silently omitting subdirectories it cannot list; it now errors for an unreadable root and marks unreadable subdirectories `[unreadable: …]` ([#15769](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15769)).
- Fixed isolated tasks losing the commits of a submodule added inside the isolation, leaving the merged checkout pinned to an unreachable commit ([#15459](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15459))
- Fixed isolated task startup hanging or detaching an unrelated checkout when `.gitmodules` lists a submodule path that is absolute or contains `.`/`..` ([#15459](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15459))
- Fixed `/live` and Ctrl+L starting live mode while the composer microphone was still loading its recognizer, which opened a second recorder and dictated into the hidden editor ([#15759](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15759))
- Fixed images in the transcript not opening their file; their placeholders and image chips now link to it ([#15872](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15872) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- Fixed print mode returning success after length-stop recovery gave up; it now waits for the session to settle before choosing its exit code ([#15732](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15732) by [@nick-maderight](https://github.com/nick-maderight))
- Fixed browser `tab.click("text/…")` passing over a match a scroll container shows only a narrow strip of and clicking a later duplicate instead ([#15792](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15792) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed `/advisor` status waiting on usage checks; it now renders immediately with cached quota data and refreshes usage in the background ([#15780](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15780) by [@mvid](https://github.com/mvid))
- Fixed task agents silently skipping `autoload-skills` entries for skills added after the session started ([#15723](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15723) by [@shyamsivakumar](https://github.com/shyamsivakumar))
- Fixed changed `initOptions` in `lsp.json` not applying when a new session reused an idle shared language server ([#15645](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15645) by [@mottopanikeiku](https://github.com/mottopanikeiku); [#15535](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15535))
- Fixed wake completions falsely reporting no output when the agent already messaged its owner over IRC ([#15834](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15834) by [@mg-mg-mg](https://github.com/mg-mg-mg)).
- Fixed a steered service readiness wait leaving the daemon broker polling until `ready.timeout`; the abandoned wait is now cancelled ([#15656](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15656))
- Fixed Cursor `;`-separated reads returning an image part's bytes as text ([#15635](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15635))
- Fixed auto-compaction ignoring `retry.waitForUsageReset` and abandoning the last compaction method on a provider-stated usage-limit reset past `retry.maxDelayMs` ([#15313](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15313))
- Fixed advisor compaction dropping the kept latest turn when the native compaction had to stop before it ([#15712](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15712))
- Fixed tool-approval steering: a message typed while viewing a subagent now steers the main session awaiting the approval, the message that denied a call is delivered ahead of older queued steers, and an equal-looking later steer no longer answers a new approval ([#15642](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15642))
- Fixed workpool item errors cancelling the entire batch; workers now continue with remaining items and report each result separately ([#15860](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15860)).
- Fixed image attachments with uppercase MIME types being dropped; supported image MIME types are now matched case-insensitively ([#15765](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15765) by [@anatoli-tsinovoy](https://github.com/anatoli-tsinovoy))
- Fixed ordinary Bash commands emitting an ignored-readiness warning for placeholder-only `ready` fields, while preserving warnings for log/port conditions and service validation ([#15629](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15629) by [@nqrwhal](https://github.com/nqrwhal)).
- `openai-models-list` discovery reads the output limit from `top_provider.max_completion_tokens` (OpenRouter-shaped catalogs such as ModelRelay), so a bundled reference with a larger limit no longer makes requests the provider rejects ([#15652](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15652) by [@shanev](https://github.com/shanev))
- Fixed saved session history being replaced by incomplete rewrites after asynchronous disk write failures ([#15588](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15588) by [@jiwangyihao](https://github.com/jiwangyihao)).
- Fixed the `read` tool description inviting `:img` on PNG paths: it now says `:img` only rasterizes SVG/SVGZ files and raster images need no selector, and the `:img` error on a raster file says to read it without the selector ([#15671](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15671) by [@nick-maderight](https://github.com/nick-maderight))
- Corrected the `ast_grep` truncated-result advice to suggest `skip` pagination or narrowing instead of `increase limit`, which the tool schema does not accept ([#15532](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15532), [#15543](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15543) by [@peda-cos](https://github.com/peda-cos)).
- Fixed Cursor sessions with many MCP tools compacting unnecessarily or pausing automatic maintenance despite ample free context ([#15815](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15815)).
- Fixed switching a session or advisor to Cursor still counting the previous model's tool schemas toward context usage and compaction ([#15815](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15815)).
- Fixed todo reminders continuing the agent when the `todo` tool is disabled ([#12589](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/12589) by [@anthonyrisinger](https://github.com/anthonyrisinger)).
- Fixed JS eval `completion()` handles created in one cell never resolving in a later cell, which left `wait(handles, { timeout })` hanging past its timeout ([#15756](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15756)).
- Closed `read :raw` line ranges now return only the requested content, and newline-terminated files report their actual line count ([#15810](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15810)).
- Fixed `/review` PR file assignments by including exact per-file diff URLs and preserving 1-based indexes across excluded files ([#15463](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15463) by [@tkossak](https://github.com/tkossak))
- Fixed `grep` and `ast_grep` returning no matches for a `path` glob that names directories, such as `src/{api,web}` or `src/we?`; matched directories are now searched recursively like a plain directory path, so `src/*` also searches files in `src`'s subdirectories ([#15760](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15760))
- Fixed a structured `display()` value in an Eval cell appearing twice in the TUI and collab view, as text in the cell box and again as the JSON tree; it now shows once, as the tree, while the model still sees the text ([#10778](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/10778), [#12730](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/12730) by [@F0Rextasy](https://github.com/F0Rextasy))
- `omp auth-gateway serve` now bounds its broker-backed session cache instead of growing with every distinct client session ([#15841](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15841)).
- Fixed the run ending when a reasoning model stops with only a signed thinking block and no reasoning text (seen with Gemini 4 via OpenRouter); the agent now continues it like any other thinking-only stop ([#15837](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15837))
- Fixed `openai-models-list` discovery ignoring a model's top-level `max_output_tokens` / `max_completion_tokens`, which let gateway models inherit an output cap as large as the whole context window and send oversized `max_completion_tokens` ([#15811](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15811))
- Fixed the standalone binary crashing with `Settings not initialized` when resuming or starting a TUI session with an extension whose dependencies clear `require.cache` (e.g. `request-promise` via `pi-messenger-bridge`) ([#15799](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15799))
- Python Eval displays preserve integers outside JavaScript's safe range as decimal strings in structured JSON instead of silently rounding them ([#15847](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15847)).
- Loop-watchdog stalls while Mnemopi truncates the recall query for compaction or background first-turn recall are now logged under `mnemopi.recall` instead of `unknown` ([#15413](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15413) by [@jaredlyon](https://github.com/jaredlyon)).
- Clarified the `/session pin` description: it pins a stored OAuth account to the current provider for this session only ([#15479](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15479) by [@iacore](https://github.com/iacore))
- Fixed `/jobs` doing nothing in a focused subagent view: it now lists that subagent's own background jobs, as does the jobs pill's sheet, without a way to cancel them; `/jobs kill` still requires returning to the main session ([#15161](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15161) by [@yuzu-octopus](https://github.com/yuzu-octopus))
- Fixed a suspended JavaScript Eval cell resolving `artifact://` and `local://` paths against the session directories of another cell that started while it was awaiting ([#15409](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15409) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed `read` ignoring JSON and JSONL `?q=` filters and pagination for `local://` and `artifact://` files ([#15767](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15767)).
- Agents can now read saved context notes without accidentally clearing them ([#15748](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15748) by [@Komzpa](https://github.com/Komzpa))
- Fixed startup without an explicit model picking an unrelated authenticated provider instead of the first available model in the configured default fallback chain ([#15781](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15781) by [@mvid](https://github.com/mvid))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-mnemopi

### Fixed

- Fixed a failing `mnemopi` CLI command or MCP memory call dropping the embeddings of memories it had just stored ([#15804](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15804) by [@yuzu-octopus](https://github.com/yuzu-octopus))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-natives

### Added

- Added `listWorkspace({ reportDirectoryErrors })`: an unreadable root fails the scan and unreadable subdirectories are returned in `unreadableDirectories` instead of being silently skipped ([#15769](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15769)).

### Fixed

- Fixed unnecessary worker scheduling overhead in `read` loops over regular files ([#15504](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15504) by [@mg-mg-mg](https://github.com/mg-mg-mg))
- Fixed `astGrep` and `astEdit` missing parse errors when Tree-sitter recovered by inserting a missing token, so edits could rewrite files that do not parse; such files are now reported and skipped ([#15530](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15530), [#15851](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15851) by [@glyahh](https://github.com/glyahh))
- Fixed `grep` and `astGrep` `glob` filters skipping the files under a directory the glob matches, so `{src,test}` or `sr?` found nothing; a matched directory now selects every file under it, so `dir/*` also matches files in `dir`'s subdirectories ([#15760](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15760))
- Fixed `grep()` and `search()` showing the start of a line wider than `maxColumns`, with no `column`, when the only match was an empty one at the end of the file (`$` or `\z` on a last line without a newline); they now show the end of the line and its column ([#15411](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15411) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed embedded-shell `xargs` failing with "Argument list too long" on large input lists instead of splitting them into executable batches ([#15708](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15708) by [@mg-mg-mg](https://github.com/mg-mg-mg))
- Fixed applying a submodule pin patch to the worktree failing with "does not exist" for a submodule directory or trying to write the pinned commit as a file; like `git apply`, the submodule's checkout is left untouched, an added pin creates its empty directory, and a removed one deletes only an empty (uninitialized) directory ([#15459](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15459))
- Fixed `diffText`/`numstat` showing a moved submodule as a delete plus an add instead of Git's 100% rename, and `applyPatch` now applies such rename patches ([#15459](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15459))
- Fixed `submodulePaths()` following `.gitmodules` paths that are absolute or contain `.`/`..`, which could point outside the repository or loop forever; like Git, such entries are ignored ([#15459](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15459))
- Fixed `copyGitObjects` exposing partially copied objects and packs to concurrent Git readers and permanently skipping a file truncated by an interrupted copy; each file is now published atomically ([#15459](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15459))
- Fixed embedded-shell `read` in a pipeline stage or async job queueing a second blocking worker while holding its own, which could hang every such read once the bounded blocking pool filled ([#15509](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15509))
- Fixed Mermaid labels decoding legacy references such as `€` or `#150;` to invisible C1 controls instead of the browser's `€` and `–` ([#15621](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15621))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-tui

### Added

- Added a tree layout to the background jobs sheet: subagents' jobs nest under the task job that runs them, busiest branches first, and Cancel appears only on the viewing agent's own jobs ([#15854](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15854) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))

### Fixed

- Fixed transcript images not opening their file: image placeholders and native image nodes now link to the source file or a stored copy ([#15872](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15872) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- A collapsing live block no longer leaves its slack as a band of blank rows between the retired history and the live rows: the slack falls below the transcript, so a streamed reply stays contiguous and the input keeps the bottom row ([#15499](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15499) by [@iacore](https://github.com/iacore))
- Fixed width-aware text on native (TSP) terminals truncating content two columns early ([#15806](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15806) by [@yuzu-octopus](https://github.com/yuzu-octopus))
- Fixed Tab/right-arrow completion silently dismissing a selected `@"quoted path"` file suggestion when the path contains spaces ([#15698](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15698) by [@drawde-nadroj](https://github.com/drawde-nadroj))
- Bracketed pastes are now capped by their UTF-8 size, so a large multibyte paste no longer buffers past the byte limit ([#15803](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15803) by [@yuzu-octopus](https://github.com/yuzu-octopus))
- Fixed OSC 66 text-sized spans bypassing truncation when their UTF-16 length was short enough to fit the fast-path guard ([#15802](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15802) by [@yuzu-octopus](https://github.com/yuzu-octopus))
- Updated the `ast_grep` result view's truncated-match note to suggest `skip` pagination instead of the schema's nonexistent `increase limit` flag ([#15532](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15532), [#15543](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15543) by [@peda-cos](https://github.com/peda-cos)).
- Fixed a streaming Edit preview with long wrapped lines growing past its row cap, because its tail was budgeted without the diff gutter its continuation rows hang under ([#15679](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15679))
- Fixed malformed base64 padding being accepted for chat image attachments before native image decoding ([#15765](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15765) by [@anatoli-tsinovoy](https://github.com/anatoli-tsinovoy)).
- Fixed Shift+Enter submitting and Ctrl+Enter inserting a newline in Windows Terminal 1.25–1.27 after closing any fullscreen view such as `/settings`; the terminal dropped omp's keyboard mode on leaving the alternate screen ([microsoft/terminal#20763](https://github.com/microsoft/terminal/issues/20763)), so omp now re-applies it ([#15868](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15868) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC)).
- Long lines in native (Tern) `read`, `write`, and code-cell source now wrap instead of scrolling each block sideways ([#15823](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15823)).
- Fixed long text pastes taking seconds to land in terminals that deliver a paste one key at a time, such as JetBrains' terminal on Windows; omp no longer writes to the terminal for every pasted key ([#15757](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15757))
- Fixed Shift+Enter submitting the prompt and Ctrl+Enter inserting a newline in WSL under Windows Terminal 1.24 and earlier, conhost, and other ConPTY hosts without kitty keyboard support; Shift+Enter now inserts a newline and Ctrl+Enter sends a follow-up, as on native Windows.
- Fixed streamed Markdown tables jumping around as each row arrives: the terminal UI fills the row being written in under the existing column widths, and native (TSP) terminals receive each row once its line is complete ([#15856](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15856) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC)).
- Fixed streamed links and inline math showing raw `[text](url` or LaTeX and then rewrapping the paragraph when they close, in the terminal UI and native (TSP) terminals: they now render in their closed form while they stream ([#15864](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15864) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC)).
- Paint-only overlays no longer swallow typing intended for the focused input beneath them ([#15793](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15793)).


## What's Changed
* fix(tui): run /jobs from a focused subagent view by @yuzu-octopus in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15161
